import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
import psutil

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
targets=("Desktop","Documents","Downloads","Pictures","Music","Videos")

def until(fn,why,timeout=30):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            value=fn()
            if value:return value
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(why)

def screenshot_b64(wrapper):
    img=wrapper.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    img.thumbnail((972,720))
    buf=io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf,format="JPEG",quality=84,optimize=True)
    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii")

def list_items(wrapper):
    return [x for x in wrapper.descendants()
            if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"]

def target_rows_from_items(items):
    found={}
    for item in items:
        try:
            name=item.element_info.name or item.window_text()
        except Exception:
            continue
        for t in targets:
            if name==t or t in name:
                found.setdefault(t,(item,name))
                break
    return found

owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-owned"
if owned.exists(): shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir()
(owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
    "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
    encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata")
env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")
for k in ("FLY_M23_OWNED_DRAG_TEST","FLY_M23_OWNED_SESSION","FLY_M23_OWNED_DRAG_TRACE"):
    env.pop(k,None)

app=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
appwrapper=None
try:
    def get_app():
        if app.poll() is not None:return None
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=app.pid)
            if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        return ws[0] if len(ws)==1 else None
    appwrapper=until(get_app,"flyExplorer window not found")
    try: appwrapper.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception: pass
    def get_fly_rows():
        files=[x for x in appwrapper.descendants()
               if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles"]
        if len(files)!=1:return None
        rows=target_rows_from_items(list_items(files[0]))
        return rows if len(rows)>=6 else None
    rows=until(get_fly_rows,"Known Folder rows did not all render",30)
    time.sleep(1)
    print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
    for t in targets:
        item,name=rows[t]
        imgs=[x for x in item.descendants()
              if x.element_info.control_type=="Image" and
                 x.element_info.name=="Windows Known Folder artwork"]
        r=item.rectangle()
        ir=imgs[0].rectangle() if imgs else None
        print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",t,repr(name),
              r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height(),
              "ARTWORK_IMAGES",len(imgs),
              "IMAGE_RECT",None if ir is None else (ir.left,ir.top,ir.width(),ir.height()),
              flush=True)
        if len(imgs)!=1:
            raise AssertionError(f"{t}: expected exactly one Known Folder artwork image, got {len(imgs)}")
    print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True)
    print(screenshot_b64(appwrapper),flush=True)
    print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if app.poll() is None:
        if appwrapper is not None:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(appwrapper.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try: app.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=8)
        else:
            app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=8)
print("FLY_PROCESS_EXIT",app.returncode,flush=True)

desktop=Desktop(backend="uia")
before=set()
for w in desktop.windows(control_type="Window"):
    try:
        if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
            before.add(w.handle)
    except Exception: pass
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe","/separate,",str(profile)])
expwrapper=None
try:
    def get_explorer():
        for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
            try:
                if w.handle in before:continue
                if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()!="explorer.exe":continue
                return w
            except Exception:pass
        return None
    expwrapper=until(get_explorer,"new Explorer window not found",20)
    try: expwrapper.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception: pass
    expwrapper.set_focus()
    send_keys("^+2")
    time.sleep(1.5)
    def get_exp_rows():
        rows=target_rows_from_items(list_items(expwrapper))
        return rows if len(rows)>=6 else None
    erows=until(get_exp_rows,"Explorer Known Folder rows not found",20)
    print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(erows),flush=True)
    for t in targets:
        item,name=erows[t]
        r=item.rectangle()
        print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",t,repr(name),
              r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height(),flush=True)
    print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True)
    print(screenshot_b64(expwrapper),flush=True)
    print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if expwrapper is not None:
        try: expwrapper.close()
        except Exception: pass
